transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in today?

Well, I... I came in because I just can't seem to shake this feeling that I've completely failed. I feel like I failed as a father, and really, just as a useful person in general. It just keeps looping in my head, over and over, until I get to the point where I feel like I don't even deserve much of a future.
Have you noticed yourself losing interest in things you used to care about or enjoy?

Yeah, I have. I used to really look forward to working on my model railway, and watching Cubs games with my daughter. But now... the trains just sit there half-built on the table. I haven't touched them. And even the idea of just turning on a baseball game on the TV... it just feels completely pointless. I just don't care about any of it anymore.
How long have you been feeling this way? Have these feelings been constant over a specific period of time?

It's been about a month now. And yeah, it's... it's been pretty constant the whole time. It really started right after my daughter left for college out of state. Ever since she moved, it's just been exactly like this every single day.
Have you ever felt this way before, where you've had a period like this where you felt down, hopeless, or uninterested in things for a long time?

No, not... not really. I mean, I've had bad days before, like anyone else, but never anything like this. I've never had a time where I just felt this completely empty and useless for weeks on end. This is the first time it's ever been like this.
Have you ever had any other periods in your life, before this one, where your mood was so low that it interfered with your life or daily activities for a period of time?

No, I haven't. Like I mentioned just a minute ago, this is really the first time. I mean, I've felt down before, sure, but it never actually stopped me from getting things done or living my life. It never got in the way like this. So, no... nothing like this has ever happened before.
Have you noticed yourself moving or speaking more slowly than usual, or on the flip side, feeling restless or fidgety more than usual?

No, I don't think so. I haven't really noticed anything like that. I'm not moving or talking any slower, and I don't feel restless or anything. I just... I just feel empty. But physically, my moving and talking seem pretty normal, I guess.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight recently?

Yeah, actually. Most days I just... I don't bother making a real meal anymore. I usually forget to eat until it gets pretty late, and even then, I only manage to have some toast or a bowl of cereal. And because of that, I've definitely lost some weight. I've had to tighten my belt a notch or two lately.
Have you noticed any changes in your sleep, like trouble falling asleep, waking up during the night, or waking up earlier than usual and not being able to go back to sleep?

Yeah, my sleep has been pretty bad. I usually just lie in bed for hours... the house gets so quiet, and I just can't drift off. And then when I do finally fall asleep, I end up waking up around three or four in the morning. Once I'm awake, that's it. I can't get back to sleep at all because my mind just starts running through everything I've messed up.
Have you had any thoughts about ending your life or that life isn't worth living anymore?

Yeah, I have. I've been having thoughts that... well, that it would just be easier if I didn't wake up. It actually scared me a bit the other day. I caught myself going over all my finances, organizing the accounts... almost like I was getting things ready for someone else to take over.
